chapters.label: Dortmund, live
chapters.text: Dortmund, Euro 2024, in a huge storm. Turkey, in red, face Georgia. A teammate wins the ball. It breaks to Arda Güler, outside the box. He curls it with his left foot... top corner! Goal!

chapters.label: Watch again
chapters.text: Watch again, slowly. He wraps his left foot around the side of the ball. It spins, and bends toward the far post.

chapters.label: The far post
chapters.text: From behind: the keeper cannot reach it. Just inside the post! He cups his ear to the crowd.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: wrap your foot around the ball, and curl it into the top corner.
